description: This file is a markdown document containing a tutorial or technical documentation on customizing request handling and routing in FastAPI, specifically through subclassing `Request` and `APIRoute` to handle gzip request bodies, access request bodies in exception handlers, and integrating these classes into routers.

classes.name: GzipRequest
classes.description: A custom subclass of `Request` that overrides the `body()` method to handle gzip compressed request bodies, decompressing them if necessary.

classes.name: GzipRoute
classes.description: A custom subclass of `APIRoute` that overrides `get_route_handler()` to use `GzipRequest` for handling incoming requests, enabling automatic gzip decompression.

methods.name: GzipRequest.body
methods.description: Overridden method to return the decompressed request body if `gzip` encoding is detected.

methods.name: GzipRoute.get_route_handler
methods.description: Returns a route handler that creates a `GzipRequest` instance from the incoming request, enabling gzip decompression logic.
